title: APOE epsilon-4 and pathological progression
allowed_conclusion: The preregistered association was supported in the discovery cohort and replicated in an independent SEA-AD source cohort. APOE epsilon-4 carriers have higher continuous pseudo-progression scores than non-carriers. This is an observational association, not evidence of causality or clinical utility. External-dataset replication remains pending.

title: Neuropathological stage and pathological progression
allowed_conclusion: The preregistered association was supported in the discovery cohort and replicated in an independent SEA-AD source cohort. Increasing AD neuropathological-change stage is monotonically associated with higher continuous pseudo-progression score. This is an observational association, not evidence of causality or clinical utility. External-dataset replication remains pending.
